title: NVIDIA GTC
metaDescription: NVIDIA GTC 2027 is scheduled for 14–18 March at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center.

overview.about: NVIDIA GTC is the chip maker's flagship AI and accelerated-computing conference, held each spring in San Jose. Once a niche graphics event, it has become one of the most closely watched dates in technology as NVIDIA's chips power the AI boom.
overview.nextEvent: The next NVIDIA GTC is held in San Jose and streamed worldwide. Its keynote sets the direction for AI hardware and software, backed by hundreds of technical sessions for developers and researchers.

@graph.name: NVIDIA GTC
@graph.description: NVIDIA GTC is the company’s flagship conference for accelerated computing and AI, centred on talks, training and its ecosystem expo. The 2027 event is scheduled for 14 to 18 March at the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, a few blocks from the city’s downtown hotels and rail connections. Sessions usually include a virtual component, but hands-on labs and the exhibition are tied to the San Jose programme.
